newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads national for theft and rape.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads national for theft and rape.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday beheaded a Saudi man for raping a maid, stealing women's handbags and burglary, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.
A statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said Mousa bin Marzouk bin Ibrahim was publicly executed in the capital Riyadh.

His head was chopped off with a sword after a court found him guilty of several crimes which also included car theft, mugging and selling stolen goods. Some of the victims were relatives and friends, the agency said.
The execution raised to 32 the number of people put to death in the conservative Islamic kingdom this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
